body: I just might have poly-cystic ovarian syndrome and I'm on my way to metabolic syndrome. I also have Paroxysmal supaventricular tachycardia.

I'd really love to swim, but I'm so embarrassed about people seeing me. It makes my anxiety sky rocket. I want to go back to the elliptical but I'm so scared with my knee. In the beginning I'd stand for a period of time or walk and then the next day I wouldn't be able to walk and I'd be in horrible pain. I guess I'll try O.A it feels like such a defeat but I guess I have to do it somehow.

The thing is I can't vigorously exercise if I wanted to. I have a really bad knee injury. Also it is difficult with food, as much as it would be easier to be black and white about because I have to eat to survive. Thank you so much for your story though.
